scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic stationary proof and derivative proof for every allowed positive parameter; standalone finite-grid rational checks are independent diagnostics, not a replacement for proof. No empirical or independent certification claim.
scientific_limitations: Two-patch constant-rate occupancy CTMC with equal positive external immigration, fixed effective colonization budget, and independently extinguishing patches; no donor cost. The stated stationary objectives do not imply finite-horizon survival or true global extinction-time performance. Historical priority provisional because some older full texts were inaccessible.
title: Opposite directional colonization allocations for regional and joint persistence
